items.question: What is your minimum order quantity?
Can I order samples before placing a production order?
What payment terms do you accept?
Can I order through Alibaba instead of by email?
items.answer: Yes. Our verified storefront carries the same catalogue and is often the faster route if you already buy through Alibaba — trade assurance, messaging and payment are handled there. For project schedules, custom finishes or master key systems, email is usually better because those need a technical conversation first.

items.question: Do you provide dimensional drawings?
items.answer: Dimensional drawings are available for most products on request. Send the model number and we will reply with what we hold for it. Where a drawing is not yet published on this site, it is because we have not verified it against the current production tooling — not because it does not exist.

items.question: Can you supply master key and construction key systems?
items.answer: Yes. Master key and construction key systems are a long-standing specialism. These are planned per project rather than ordered from a catalogue, so start with the door schedule and we will work back from it.

items.question: Which finishes are available?
items.answer: Available finishes are listed on each product page under Configuration. Where a product page shows no finishes, that information has not yet been verified for that model and we would rather leave it blank than guess.

items.question: Can you produce to our own design or branding (OEM / ODM)?
Is Canton Hyland ISO 9001 certified?
items.answer: Yes. The company has held ISO 9001 certification since 2002.

items.question: Are your panic exit devices EN 1125 certified?
items.answer: Test reports exist for specific models rather than for the range as a whole, and we do not extend a report from one model to a sibling product. The reports are issued for the exclusive use of the party that commissioned them and may only be passed on in full, so we send them on request against a named model rather than publishing extracts. Tell us the model you intend to specify and we will send the report that covers it, or say plainly that there is not one.

items.question: Can you supply test reports and certificates for a tender?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us the models on the schedule and we will send the reports that name them, with their issue dates and scope.

items.question: Where are your products manufactured?
items.answer: In Guangdong, China. Canton Hyland Hardware (Group) Co., Ltd. has manufactured commercial and residential door hardware since 1998.

items.question: Do you export worldwide?
items.answer: Yes. Our panic devices, lock cases, lever sets and floor springs are specified in commercial, institutional and residential buildings across more than thirty export markets. Tell us the destination country and our export team will confirm documentation and shipping for it.
